title: EXTENSION-SCHEMA-SYNC

iterations.prompt: Synchronize the VS Code extension and the GraphQL schema with the Go backend and fix the 'expected iterable' runtime error.
iterations.author: Ueli Saluz <ueli.saluz@iek.uni-hannover.de>

summary: Synchronized the VS Code extension and the GraphQL schema with the Go backend (main.go). Fixed the 'expected iterable' runtime error by adding a custom resolver in Go to convert the Edits map to a slice. Updated the extension query to fetch the full codebase graph and increased buffer/timeout limits for large repository handling.
